```plato

//==
// # Placed signed distance fields
//
// A source SDF moved off the origin. The distance primitives in
// `implicit-sdf.library.plato` are all written centred at the origin and
// axis-aligned, which is what keeps their bodies short and portable; placement is
// this wrapper's job rather than a parameter on every primitive.
//
// Pose and uniform scale, and nothing wider, because these are the only maps that
// carry a signed distance field to another signed distance field: a rigid motion
// preserves distance outright, and a uniform scale multiplies every distance by
// the same factor. Non-uniform scale and shear stretch the pulled-back distance
// by up to their largest factor, so the result can EXCEED the true distance and
// is not a bound at all until divided by that factor; they are deliberately not
// expressible here. Compose an `AffineTransform*D` with the field by hand if
// that is acceptable.
// Operations live in `implicit-sdf.library.plato`.

// A planar SDF placed by a rigid pose and a uniform scale. Distances are the
// source field's multiplied by Scale, so the source's fidelity survives: an
// exact source stays exact. Precondition: Scale is positive.
type PlacedSdf2D
    implements IValue, IDifferentiableSignedDistanceField2D
{
    Source: FunctionSdf2D;
    Pose: Pose2D;
    Scale: Number;
}
```
